ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a rectangular building floor plan, with an opening for the kangaroo to enter on the left, and several exits marked a, b, c, d, e arranged vertically on the right. The interior of the building is divided into different rooms by many line segments, some of which are triangular rooms and some are not. Then reason: The problem requires that the kangaroo pass only through triangular rooms, so it must start from the left entrance and only do connected expansion along triangular rooms connected to the entrance; when it meets quadrilateral or other non-triangular regions, it cannot go. Tracing the connected chain of triangular rooms in the picture toward the lower right, one can see that this triangular-room component finally connects to the lowest exit on the right side, corresponding to the label e; the other exits are not on this triangular connected path. Therefore the kangaroo leaves from exit e.

raw_record.question_text: A kangaroo enters the building and only passes through triangular rooms. Through which labeled exit does he leave the building?

method.method_draft: Use a visual flood-fill of triangular rooms. First inspect the floor-plan image: locate the kangaroo entering through the opening on the left wall, the labeled exits a, b, c, d, e on the right wall, and the interior partitions that form rooms of different shapes. Starting from the room immediately inside the entrance, mark only those rooms whose boundary has exactly three sides. Then continue marking any adjacent room reachable from a marked triangular room, but only if that adjacent room is also triangular; ignore quadrilateral or other non-triangular regions. The connected chain/component of triangular rooms from the entrance winds through the building and reaches the lower-right exit labeled e, while the other labeled exits are not in this triangular-room component. Therefore the kangaroo leaves through exit e.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个长方形建筑平面图，左侧有袋鼠进入的开口，右侧竖直排列着标记为 a、b、c、d、e 的几个出口。建筑内部由很多线段分隔成不同房间，其中有些是三角形房间，有些不是。

再推理：题目要求袋鼠只经过三角形房间，所以要从左侧入口开始，只沿着与入口连通的三角形房间做连通扩展，遇到四边形或其他非三角形区域就不能走。沿图中三角形房间的连通链往右下方追踪，可以看到这条三角形房间组件最终连到最下方右侧的出口，对应标记 e；其余出口不在这条三角形连通路径上。因此袋鼠从 e 出口离开。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct graph/flood-fill route: model rooms as nodes, adjacency as possible movement, and restrict the traversal to nodes that are visually triangular. Since only one honest solution route is needed, this gives the executable primary method.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the entrance on the left, the labeled exits a–e on the right, the wall layout, and which enclosed regions are triangular versus non-triangular. The final connected triangular path is seen to end at exit e.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the condition that the kangaroo only passes through triangular rooms and the question asking which labeled exit he uses.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the geometric rule that a triangular room has exactly three sides, and the maze-tracing rule that movement is allowed only through adjacent rooms satisfying that condition.
